$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (#target, or the ellipsis for the Pagination Ellipsis entry) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

items.$why: The list is as wide as its labels ("Previous", "Next", page numbers), whose widths follow glyph rasterisation; the pixel check covers the layout.

Previous.$why: The width follows the label's glyph rasterisation; padding, gap and radius are compared.

Next.$why: The width follows the label's glyph rasterisation; padding, gap and radius are compared.

Button.$why: Figma's current page is an Outline Button that keeps the default 8 px side padding inside its fixed 32 px width, while the other page links have none; the code gives every page link the same box (no padding, a 32 px minimum width), so the size, radius, fill and stroke are compared.
